reference.convention: d=T_mid=rho_mid=R=1; eta=ri/ro; a=1; D=.5; gamma=5/3; Pr=1; constant inward g=cp*D; constant mu,K
reference.background_formula: B=a*ri*ro, A=1-B/rm; T=1-B*z/(r*rm); p=exp(-g*J),rho=p/T; J=z/A-B/A^2*log1p(A*z/rm), or J=z+z^2/(2rm) at A=0
reference.method: Independent mixed-degree Chebyshev collocation (U,w,T degree n; p degree n-2; interior continuity), neutral Rayleigh and fully compressible growth pencils; sampled global-k bracket plus neighboring integer degrees; independent dense off-grid differential residual
reference.scope: Poloidal ell>=1 stationary onset; m-degenerate. Global search is a numerical bracket audit, not a proof for unbounded ell. Values are independently computed, not quoted spherical results.

neutral_eigenmode.normalization: max(abs(w))=chi on these centers; multiply all fields by runner seed
